provenance: Measured config, 28 Nov 2026: phase_e.json design choices + measured sensor (pooled s1 + A2 range fit, s1 bearing_cal bin_model), rover1 steering table and transport delay. Speed table measured. amplitude_noise 8.0 counts.

sources.sigma_deg: Gaussian fit, horn_model_parameters.txt (clipped alternative: w=25, sigma=52)
sources.amplitude_constant: K=84 counts*m; valid only at 30% laptop volume and the current gain-screw position
sources.range_exponent: 1/rho model assumed by the horn model; not separately fitted
sources.horn_limit_deg: phi_max=80: firmware upper bound only; experiments set dither separately, capped at 60
sources.horn_limit_left_deg: servo end stop 180 deg minus the per-mount centre 110 deg = +70. Recompute if the centre is re-measured after reattaching the horn
sources.measurement_period: E4: T_m=0.477 s at delta=50 (T_m = 0.144 + delta/150 s)
sources.pair_gap: E4: dt_pair=0.405 s at delta=50 (0.072 + delta/150 s)
sources.range_noise_floor: small absolute floor so the floor stays positive; the measured floor is relative
sources.bearing_noise_floor_deg: sb_floor=15-20 deg; upper value used (held-out bias reaches 30-40 deg)
sources.vehicle: NOT MEASURED: wheelbase, speeds, steering, lags, braking, clearance are synthetic
sources.servo_center_deg: 110 deg (firmware constant): per-mount calibration, horn not aligned 1:1 with the servo; re-measure after any remount

sources_horn12.beacon: Data/stimuli/horn12.wav from Data/stimuli/horn12_spec.json: gains -7.4..0 dB invert the s1 speaker+horn response (47 captures), so all 12 tones reach the ADC within ~1 dB; 0 dB tone 0.221 FS at peak 0.9, crest factor 2.41
sources_horn12.bin_model: null: fit with rover.bearing_cal --per-tone on the horn12 B0 sweeps, then copy bin_model from proposed_config.json. With bin_model set, bearing_gain_correction must be 1 and boresight_deg 0
sources_horn12.bin_weights: null: equal power over the 12 tones (already flat at the ADC by pre-emphasis) for the range amplitude
sources_horn12.multipath_model: PROVISIONAL from Phase B s1 (wide16, per-tone BLUE, held out): fringe_ln_sd 0.144 = 12 deg bearing / (59 deg per neper * sqrt 2) from the B2 7.5 cm swing; room_bearing_sd_deg 23 = sqrt(26.2^2 - 12^2) from the E3 held-out RMS; fringe_length_m 0.043 = lambda/2 at 4 kHz; room_length_m 1.0 assumed. Used by rover.simulation.MultipathModel. Re-estimate from the horn12 session

design_phase_e.desired_range: 1.4 m: smallest separation at which the safety speed governor (rho - 3 sigma_rho - clearance - stop_margin, braking with timeout+tau_speed = 1.55 s) still allows v_t = 0.18 m/s with range floor 0.10 rho (O1/O4 coupling, Phase E fig. 3)
design_phase_e.range_noise_floor_rel: 0.10: multi-tone range, s1 held-out ~8 % RMS at 1-1.5 m (4 poses) and B2 sd 15 %; re-estimate from horn12 E3
design_phase_e.bearing_noise_floor_deg: 13 = sqrt(6^2 + 12^2): per-pair noise (s1, 5-6 deg) plus the fast fringe (s1 B2 sd ~12 deg), both white at the measurement rate because the follower moves 8.6 cm per T_m; the slow room bias is NOT white and is not in R
design_phase_e.max_range_std / max_bearing_std_deg: 0.40 m / 25 deg = ~2x the p95 of the steady TRACK posterior (0.19 m, 13 deg): the gates detect divergence after lost measurements, not normal operation (the former 0.25 m / 12 deg sat at the median and kept the loop in HOLD)
design_phase_e.range_domain: 0.27-2.5 m: PROVISIONAL, requires the horn12 B0/E3 poses at 2.0-2.4 m; with 2.03 m the target leaves the calibrated domain during acquisition
design_phase_e.acquire_pairs: 2 (was 3): 2 consistent pairs (~1 s) before motion; 3 pairs let the target walk out of the range domain
design_phase_e.lqr_q / lqr_r: Bryson's rule: max tolerated |e| 0.41 m, |beta| 40 deg, |eps| 65 deg, integral 1.8 m s; |dv| 0.2 m/s, |w| 0.29 rad/s. Gives crossover 0.68/0.60 rad/s, delay margin 1.2/1.7 s beyond T_eff 0.52 s, disk margin 0.79/0.99
design_phase_e.range_poles / bearing_poles: pole-placement comparison design at omega_n = 0.3 rad/s (crossover ~0.75 rad/s, delay margin 1.0/1.2 s); 0.4 rad/s leaves 0.6 s and 0.5 rad/s only 0.35 s
design_phase_e.multipath: 0 here; Phase E evaluates explicit levels: none, horn12 target (fringe 0.07, room 10 deg) and s1 (0.144, 23 deg)
design_phase_e.observer_qw: Process-noise intensities of the linear 5-state design observer [d_rho, beta, eps, dv_t, w_t] (MATLAB acoustic_pursuit_design, Phase E fig. 3): model error 1e-3 on the kinematic states; target speed and yaw-rate changes of ~0.05 m/s and ~0.03 rad/s within ~1 s. Gives range/bearing observer modes at -0.63 1/s (1.5x the fastest controller pole); the heading/turn-rate pair stays near -0.18+-0.27j for any Qw because eps is only weakly observable (a = v0/d* = 0.13 1/s). The runtime EKF uses process_acceleration_noise instead

sources_measured.amplitude_constant / range_exponent / si: pooled per-pair fit (rover.calibrate model), s1 20 Nov + A2 28 Nov, 1.0-1.5 m, 3168 amplitudes, sigma fixed at 77 deg (simulator bearing scale), b 0, n 1: K 30.9 at volume 20 %, log-RMSE 0.122 (n free: 0.975 +- 0.026; sigma free: K 27.3, sigma 117, n 1.01, same range near beta = 0). Rescaled to the live setup (volume 80 %, gain trimmer mid, blanking firmware) by the 1.0 m median-A ratio 2.18: K 67.4. The bearing bin_model is a per-tone log ratio, so a flat gain/volume change cancels
sources_measured.range_noise_floor_rel: 0.15 = per-pair ~10 % (+) pose-to-pose room bias ~+-10 % at 1.0-1.5 m
sources_measured.range_domain: 0.75-2.5 m gate on rho_hat (the in-room rho_hat stays <= ~1.6 m for true ranges <= 2.0 m; the 2.5 m edge avoids artificial rejections at the simulated 2.0 m Tier 1 start). Accurate only on 1.0-1.5 m: 0.75 m reads -20 %, 2.0 m reads as 1.5 m
sources_measured.bin_model: Runs/2026-11-28/20261128T062919_226852Z_bearing_cal (s1 B0 training, E3 held out 27.6 deg RMS)
sources_measured.amplitude_noise: 8.0 counts. Measured per-pair A sd at 1.0 m, volume 80 %: 1.9 motors off and at PWM 45/80 (motors do not raise the amplitude scatter, ~3.3 % of A); in-band N rises 1.2 -> 8.0 (PWM 45) / 5.4 (PWM 80), and the live estimator uses N as the per-pair noise, so the motor variant uses 8.0 (conservative)
sources_measured.speed_table: rover.identify fit, Runs/2026-11-28/20261128T155805_660561Z_identify_speed: PWM 25/45/80 -> 0.041/0.100/0.203 m/s; listening while driving validated at PWM 45 and 80 (100 % valid, 0 % clip, volume 80 %)
sources_measured.fringe_ln_sd / room_bearing_sd_deg: 0 in the config (phase_e.json convention); the s1 measured level (0.144, 23 deg) is applied per scenario by rover.phase_e. For other simulations pass it in the scenario.
sources_measured.wheelbase: SunFounder PiCar-V manual, minimum turning radius 138 mm at 45 deg
